dishes.name: Van breakfast
dishes.desc: A large spread of herb cheese, honey with kaymak, olives, eggs and fresh bread. Van's breakfast houses are known across Türkiye.

dishes.name: Keledoş
dishes.desc: Hearty stew of kurut (dried yoghurt), wheat, chickpeas and beans with meat and wild herbs, finished with butter. A registered Van speciality served in traditional restaurants.

dishes.name: Van herbed cheese
dishes.desc: Sheep's-milk cheese kneaded with wild mountain herbs such as sivri and heliz. A staple on Van breakfast tables.

dishes.name: Kürt köftesi
dishes.desc: Bulgur and meat dumplings served in a tomato-based soup. A Van home dish found in local lokantas.

dishes.name: Van çöreği
dishes.desc: Soft, buttery bread roll from Van's bakeries, eaten fresh with the city's famous breakfast or with tea.
